name: Plan a topic cluster from keywords to briefs and links
why: A guided run from keyword research to a pillar and cluster plan, post briefs and internal links.

name: Customer question keyword finder
why: Turns reviews, tickets and comments into the questions people search for, the starting point for topics here.

name: Keyword to post outline writer
why: A quick one-page outline with intent and headings, for smaller pieces that do not need a full brief.

name: Search title and snippet writer
why: Writes search titles and descriptions within length limits, for the fix-the-click decision.

name: Zero-click content planner
why: Plans content that helps buyers where they already are, for when AI answers and social keep people off your site.

name: Monthly Search Console keeper
why: A monthly agent that reads the Search Console export and lists pages to push, thin pages to fix and next posts.

name: Find old posts losing traffic and refresh or cut them
why: A full workflow for the refresh, merge or cut decisions in the quarterly review.

name: Monthly content decay keeper
why: Catches pages losing ground each month and drafts the fix for approval.

name: Monthly content repurposer
why: Picks last month's best pieces and turns them into posts, emails and clips to approve.

name: X and LinkedIn post pair writer
why: Writes channel-native social versions of one idea, as the repurposing workflow requires.

name: Weekly newsletter keeper
why: Drafts, edits and checks each newsletter issue against the brand voice.

name: Help article writer from support tickets
why: Turns repeated support questions into short articles in the customer's words.

name: Anti-AI-slop copy editor
why: A second editing pass that fixes machine-sounding lines in AI-assisted drafts.

name: Content growth experiment planner
why: Plans a focused content growth test with costs and measures, for testing a new channel.
